name: Harbor Foods (fictional): ready for a pilot

identify_pain.evidence: Stockouts cost about $3M a year; figure agreed in the shared discovery summary dated Oct 14.

metrics.evidence: Cut stockouts 20% vs. last year's baseline, measured weekly from the planning system; agreed in the pilot charter.

economic_buyer.evidence: CFO joined the Oct 21 call and asked for a go/no-go readout after the pilot.

champion.evidence: VP Supply Chain presented the case internally and introduced the CFO.

decision_criteria.evidence: Buyer listed three criteria on the Oct 21 call; two are written in the charter.

decision_process.evidence: Pilot readout, then CFO review, then procurement. Owners named; dates not yet fixed.

paper_process.evidence: Security review takes about three weeks; reviewer identified.

competition.evidence: Buyer named an in-house build as the alternative.
